metadata.purpose: Generic picosecond pump configuration for Ho:YAG when the exact pump laser is not yet known.
metadata.status: simulation prior, not a specification of a real laser
metadata.policy: Keep all source-dependent laser parameters configurable. Defaults are chosen only to exercise the simulator in a moderate regime.

wavelength_and_material.source_for_dispersion: Zelmon YAG Sellmeier equation already stored in Stage 0

recommended_initial_sweeps.note: These are numerical exploration ranges, not guaranteed safe or representative operating limits for a specific laser/crystal. Enforce average-power, fluence, and damage constraints once the actual source is known.

transform_limited_gaussian_spectrum.spectral_resolution_rule: If the actual pump bandwidth is not small compared with the Ho:YAG absorption feature, integrate sigma_a(lambda,T) over the pump spectrum instead of using a single cross section.
transform_limited_gaussian_spectrum.practical_flag: For an unchirped Gaussian near 1908 nm, pulses around 1 ps have bandwidth comparable to the 4.5 nm absorption feature; 10 ps pulses are much narrower.

linear_dispersion_derived_from_sellmeier.note: Derived numerically from the Stage 0 Sellmeier model. For multi-ps pulses through 18 mm this is modest; it becomes more relevant as pulses shorten or broaden spectrally.

saturation_estimates.note: The nominal placeholder is intentionally far below this rough saturation scale. If the eventual pulse fluence approaches F_sat, resolve population changes inside the pump pulse.

optional_nonlinear_optics.source_note: Commonly cited YAG value at 1064 nm; not validated here at 1908 nm.
optional_nonlinear_optics.enable_rule: Enable Kerr/SPM if actual pulse energy/spot size makes B-integral non-negligible. Replace n2 with a validated value at the pump wavelength if available.

numerical_model_flags.thermal_coupling: accumulate deposited energy per pulse and evolve temperature on the slow thermal timescale
